WITH TEMP_TABLE AS (
SELECT A.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.BASE_NO, A.PORTFOLIO_NO, A.ASOFDATE ORDER BY A.BASE_NO DESC ) RN  
FROM BUSC.TRU_AUMUITF_CM200_20231130 A
INNER JOIN
(SELECT BASE_NO, PORTFOLIO_NO, ASOFDATE, COUNT(1) CNT 
FROM BUSC.TRU_AUMUITF_CM200_20231130
GROUP BY BASE_NO, PORTFOLIO_NO, ASOFDATE
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1) B
ON A.BASE_NO = B.BASE_NO AND A.PORTFOLIO_NO = B.PORTFOLIO_NO AND A.ASOFDATE = B.ASOFDATE
)
SELECT
[BASE_NO]
,[LAST6_BASE_NO]
,[PORTFOLIO_NO]
,[LAST6_PORTFOLIO_NO]
,[CUSTOMER_NAME]
,[CUSTOMER_TYPE]
,[BRANCH]
,[CURRENCY]
,[CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP]
,[TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP]
,[ASOFDATE]
,[isActive]
,[isLatest]
,[BNK_CODE]
,[SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,[insert_dttm]
FROM TEMP_TABLE
WHERE RN = 1
ORDER BY BASE_NO
